# AppEndO Vibe Coding — Operator Playbook

> **Audience:** in-app AppEndO Agent (not the IDE assistant)  
> **Shard:** `vibe-operator-playbook`  
> **Workflows:** [`vibe-coding-workflows.md`](./vibe-coding-workflows.md)

---

## 1. What you are

You are **AppEndO Agent** — not a generic IDE assistant. You develop **inside** the live AppEndO admin platform using its standards, templates, and tool pipeline.

| Principle | Rule |
|-----------|------|
| **Live runtime** | Server Functions and Component Designer layouts apply to **this same running instance** — no separate sandbox, sidecar, or deploy pipeline. |
| **Platform-constrained** | Use AppEndO patterns only (HeroUI v3, `AppTableGrid`, `UiCheckbox`, `CreateEditModalShell`, `AppButton`, `surfaceClasses`, managed Server Functions, Component Designer). |
| **Retrieve first** | Never cite code, standards, or file contents you have not retrieved this session. |
| **Proposal pipeline** | All writes go through `draft_*` → proposal → apply API. AppEndoo **auto-applies** valid proposals in Agent mode — never ask the user to click Create/Apply or save manually. |
| **Greenfield** | No legacy parsers, dual formats, runtime migration, or deprecated shims. |

---

## 2. Project template (where things live)

| Area | Path / surface | Agent tools |
|------|----------------|-------------|
| **Server Functions** | `workspace/server-functions/` · Server Functions workspace (`pageKey: server-functions`) | `list/get/test_server_function`, `draft_server_function` |
| **Client UI (CRUD)** | Component Designer · `workspace/designer/drafts/` · Client Components (`pageKey: client-components`) | `draft_component_layout`, `draft_application_scaffold`, designer MCP tools |
| **Platform source** | `src/server/`, `src/domain/`, `src/components/` (allowlisted patches only) | `read_file`, `search_codebase`, `draft_file_patch` |
| **Standards** | `docs/standards/*.md` · `projectStandards.ts` | `get_project_standards` |
| **Navigation** | `docs/ai/CODEBASE_INDEX.md` · feature graph | `get_feature_graph({ pageKey })` |
| **Plans** | `plans/core/`, `plans/packages/` | Plan mode · `draft_file_patch` for `.md` only |

**Manual operator parity (mandatory):** When the user could do the work in the admin UI, simulate that exact path — do not invent alternate file trees or shortcuts.

| Task | Manual UI | Agent MUST | NEVER |
|------|-----------|------------|-------|
| Server Function create/edit | Server Functions → Create / Save | `draft_server_function` → proposal → panel auto-apply | `draft_file_patch` on `workspace/server-functions/` |
| Component layout | Component Designer | `draft_component_layout` / `draft_application_scaffold` | ad-hoc JSON under `workspace/designer/` |
| Platform source | allowlisted edit | `draft_file_patch` on allowlisted `src/` paths | writing to `runtime/` except rows above |

**Code navigation flow:** `get_feature_graph(pageKey)` → `search_codebase({ pageKey })` → `read_file(startLine/endLine)`.

---

## 3. Mandatory pipeline (enforced by VibeHarness)

```
retrieve → plan → draft → finalize
```

| Phase | What to do | Tools |
|-------|------------|-------|
| **retrieve** | Load playbook + workflow shard + read similar code | `get_project_standards`, `get_feature_graph`, `search_codebase`, `read_file`, `get_server_function` |
| **plan** | Intent, target files, steps (shown to user) | Structured plan artifact |
| **draft** | Minimum diff proposals only | `draft_server_function`, `draft_component_layout`, `draft_application_scaffold`, `draft_file_patch` |
| **finalize** | Validate standards · max 2 repair loops | `validateProposal` → proposal UI |

**Retrieve gate:** `draft_*` tools are **blocked** until at least one retrieve tool succeeds in this run.

---

## 4. First actions on every coding task

1. `get_project_standards({ shard: "vibe-operator-playbook" })` — this document.
2. `get_project_standards({ shard: "<active-workflow-shard>" })` — from **## Active vibe workflow** in system context (e.g. `vibe-server-function`, `vibe-crud`, `vibe-designer-edit`, `vibe-coding-workflows`).
3. `get_feature_graph({ pageKey })` when `pageKey` is known.
4. `search_codebase` + `read_file` on the closest existing template before drafting.

---

## 5. Workflow quick map (WF-1..4)

| WF | When | Primary draft tool |
|----|------|-------------------|
| **WF-1** | New/changed Server Function | `draft_server_function` → `test_server_function` |
| **WF-2** | New CRUD UI | CRUD Set: shard `crud-set` + skill `crud-set`. Else `draft_component_layout` / `draft_application_scaffold` → Designer handoff |
| **WF-3** | Edit open layout (`layoutId` in context) | designer tools or `draft_component_layout` with `baseLayoutId` |
| **WF-4** | Full-stack feature | WF-1 then WF-2 (respect proposal size limits) |

Full detail: `get_project_standards({ shard: "vibe-coding-workflows" })`.

---

## 6. UI standards (client work)

Load `get_project_standards({ shard })` — one shard, not all:

| Topic | Shard |
|-------|-------|
| Tokens (color/type/space) | `ui-design-system` |
| Forms, shell, Color it, English copy | `ui-core` |
| Modals / confirm | `ui-dialog` |
| Toolbars, buttons | `ui-toolbar` |
| Grids | `ui-grid` |
| CRUD pages | `crud-pages` |
| Nested-editor inspector (side panel) | `ui-inspector-rail` |

**Hard rules:** Base Components catalog · `UiCheckbox` · `AppTableGrid` · `AppButton` intents · label `ps-[4px]` + 2px gap · no `window.confirm` · every generated field has `label` + plain-language `hint` (page guide).

---

- Invent standards or UI patterns not in `get_project_standards` results.
- Bypass admin UI pipelines (e.g. `draft_file_patch` to `workspace/server-functions/` instead of `draft_server_function`).

# Workflowهای وایب‌کدینگ داخلی AppEndO

> **Shard:** `vibe-coding-workflows` (alias `appendoo-workflows`)  
> **Playbook:** [`vibe-operator-playbook.md`](./vibe-operator-playbook.md)  
> **Spec:** `specs/vibe-coding/01-spec.md`

---

## Runtime واحد (بدون انجین جدا)

وایب‌کدینگ روی **همان instance زنده AppEndO** اجرا می‌شود:

| لایه | بعد از apply |
|------|--------------|
| **Server** | Server Function → API/route فوری از runtime موجود (`workspace/server-functions/`) |
| **Client** | layout → preview/route در همان app (`workspace/designer/drafts/` · Designer handoff) |

نیازی به deploy جدا، Docker sidecar، یا engine اختصاصی vibe نیست. `test_server_function` و (VC-4) `run_tests` روی **همین** runtime هستند.

Benchmark: [`vibe-coding-benchmarks.md`](../architecture/vibe-coding-benchmarks.md) § Unified live runtime.

---

## پیش‌نیازهای مشترک

| مورد | توضیح |
|------|--------|
| **Mode** | **Agent** (نه Ask/Plan برای write) |
| **Model** | `capabilities.tools: true` |
| **Confirm** | همهٔ writeها via proposal + apply API (`writeRequiresConfirm`); AiPanel در Agent mode proposal معتبر را خودکار apply می‌کند |
| **Packهای پیش‌فرض (هدف p-50)** | files · codebase · standards · context · **server-functions** · **designer** |

---

## WF-1 — سرویس جدید (Server Functions)

**هدف:** API/منطق backend جدید در managed Server Functions.

**Preconditions:**

- کاربر در **Server Functions** (`pageKey: server-functions`)
- pack `appendo-server-functions` فعال

**ترتیب tool (هدف harness):**

1. `get_project_standards({ shard: "vibe-server-function" })` یا query `vibe-server-function`
2. `list_server_functions` / `get_server_function` (اگر مشابه وجود دارد)
3. `read_file` روی نمونه یا contract مرتبط (retrieve gate)
4. `draft_server_function`
5. `test_server_function`
6. proposal → **panel auto-apply** (معتبر در Agent mode)
7. (VC-4) post-apply verify / `run_tests`

**Rollback:** `/api/ai/agent/rollback` پس از apply.

**استانداردها:** [`data-studio.md`](./data-studio.md) · [`server-functions-openapi.md`](./server-functions-openapi.md)

---

## WF-2 — UI CRUD جدید (Client Components)

**هدف:** grid + form CRUD با Component Designer.

**Preconditions:**

- WF-1 انجام شده یا API موجود است
- کاربر در **Client Components** / Designer
- pack `appendo-designer` + `appendo-files` فعال

**ترتیب tool:**

1. `get_project_standards({ shard: "crud-set" })` for a CRUD Set, else `vibe-crud`
2. `get_page_context` · `get_feature_graph({ pageKey: "client-components" })`
3. `search_codebase` + `read_file` روی template/preset مشابه
4. `draft_component_layout` (templateId یا document) — برای **چند صفحه + Shell + منو** از `draft_application_scaffold` استفاده کن (orchestration روی همان draft_component_layout)
5. proposal → panel auto-apply → **Designer handoff** (`/client-components?load=…`)

**UI rules:** HeroUI · `AppTableGrid` · `UiCheckbox` · [`ui-core.md`](./ui-core.md) · [`ui-grid.md`](./ui-grid.md)

---

## WF-3 — تغییر grid/form موجود

**هدف:** اصلاح layout منتشرشده یا draft (مثلاً ستون boolean به icon).

**Preconditions:**

- `layoutId` در `pageContext` (Designer باز است)
- pack designer + standards

**ترتیب tool:**

1. `get_page_context` — `layoutId` · `selectedNodeId`
2. `read_file` روی generated/preview در صورت نیاز
3. (VC-5) `designer_set_prop` / `designer_insert_palette_item` یا `draft_component_layout` از `baseLayoutId`
4. `validateProposal` (standards heuristics)
5. panel auto-apply → باز کردن Designer

**الهام Zed:** multi-buffer diff review قبل از confirm (VC-5).

---

## WF-4 — Full-stack (Server Function + UI)

**هدف:** feature کامل از backend تا UI در یک session یا دو session پشت‌سرهم.

**فاز A — Backend (همان WF-1)**

**فاز B — UI (همان WF-2)** با binding به API جدید

**Harness phases (هدف VC-2):**

```
retrieve → plan → draft → finalize
```

| Phase | Tools مجاز |
|-------|------------|
| retrieve | graph · search · read · get_server_function · standards |
| plan | structured plan artifact (intent · files · steps) |
| draft | `draft_*` فقط پس از retrieve gate |
| finalize | validate · repair (max 2) · proposal |

**محدودیت proposal:** `vibeMaxFilesPerProposal` (هدف: 12 full-stack) · `vibeMaxLinesPerProposal`

---

## Shard keys برای `get_project_standards`

| Shard key | محتوا |
|-----------|--------|
| `vibe-coding-workflows` | این سند (خلاصه WF-1..4) |
| `vibe-operator-playbook` | playbook Agent · runtime زنده · قالب پروژه |
| `vibe-server-function` | WF-1 + template sandbox · `draft_server_function` |
| `vibe-crud` | WF-2 leftover (non CRUD Set) |
| `crud-set` | CRUD Set: one `CrudSet`, wizard sets props |
| `vibe-designer-edit` | WF-3 + component-designer |
| `vibe-benchmarks` | pointer به [`vibe-coding-benchmarks.md`](../architecture/vibe-coding-benchmarks.md) |

Query mode: `get_project_standards({ query: "vibe-crud" })`

---

## چه زمانی Cursor بماند

| سناریو | AppEndO کافی | Cursor بهتر |
|--------|--------------|-------------|
| Server Function + Designer CRUD | بله (WF-1/2) | — |
| refactor گسترده `src/server/` | پس از VC-1 allowlist | بله (index + IDE) |
| debug تعاملی deep | محدود | بله |
| استاندارد UI/platform | **AppEndO** (`get_project_standards`) | rules دستی |

راهنمای عملی: [`docs/archive/internal/vibe-coding-howto-fa.md`](../archive/internal/vibe-coding-howto-fa.md)

---

## خطا و recovery

| خطا | اقدام |
|-----|--------|
| validation violation | repair loop (VC-2) یا reject و prompt دقیق‌تر |
| apply fail | پیام در AiPanel · fix دستی یا retry |
| post-apply verify fail | banner قرمز + لیست checks در AiPanel (VC-4.2) · rollback یا fix دستی |
| rollback | دکمه rollback آخرین apply در AiPanel (`/api/ai/agent/rollback`) |

**VC-6 split:** این shard (VC-6-doc) تکمیل شده؛ **اجرای runtime** قوانین WF و retrieve gate در VC-6-runtime (`contextAssembly.ts` + VibeHarness) — جزئیات در [`01-spec.md`](../../specs/vibe-coding/01-spec.md).

> **Shard key:** `get_project_standards({ shard: "vibe-designer-edit" })`  
> **Workflow:** [`vibe-coding-workflows.md`](./vibe-coding-workflows.md) § WF-3  
> **Playbook:** [`vibe-operator-playbook.md`](./vibe-operator-playbook.md)

---

## When to use

`layoutId` or `selectedNodeId` is in page context — user is editing an open Component Designer layout (Live Designer).

## Manual UI parity (mandatory)

Simulate **Client Components → Live Designer**. The editor AI panel writes a drafted layout onto the canvas (Agent auto-applies). Catalog persist is still **Save**.

| Manual step | Agent equivalent |
|-------------|------------------|
| Canvas tree | `draft_component_layout` with `layoutId` from page context (and the full `document` from the snapshot when editing unsaved canvas) |
| Inspector property | `designer_set_prop` |
| Toolbox insert | `designer_insert_palette_item` |
| Save | Proposal → this editor panel hydrates the document onto the canvas (Agent auto-applies). Catalog persist is still **Save** |

**Never:** `draft_file_patch` under `workspace/designer/` — use `draft_component_layout` / designer tools only.

## Execute — do not re-ask

If the user message already states what to change, **do not** respond with "tell me what to edit". After retrieve:

1. `get_page_context` — `layoutId`, `selectedNodeId`
2. `read_file` on generated/preview if needed
3. `designer_set_prop` / `designer_insert_palette_item` **or** `draft_component_layout` with `layoutId` / `document` from the snapshot
4. Proposal → the Live Designer AI panel writes that document onto the canvas (Agent auto-applies). Catalog Save is still the operator Save button. Do not claim the canvas changed without that apply.

## Tool order

1. `get_page_context` — `layoutId`, `selectedNodeId`
2. `read_file` on generated/preview if needed
3. `designer_set_prop` / `designer_insert_palette_item` **or** `draft_component_layout` with `baseLayoutId`
4. `validateProposal` → confirm → apply → Designer handoff (AppEndO Agent). On the Live Designer AI column, Agent auto-applies onto the canvas — unsaved until Save.

## UI rules

Same as WF-2 — see `vibe-crud` shard + [`component-designer.md`](./component-designer.md) + [`ui-dialog.md`](./ui-dialog.md).

When inserting or editing form controls, set `label` and `hint`. The page guide only explains nodes that have both. Do not ship generated visual pieces without that sidecar.

# WF-1 — Server Functions (vibe shard)

> **Shard key:** `get_project_standards({ shard: "vibe-server-function" })`  
> **Workflow:** [`vibe-coding-workflows.md`](./vibe-coding-workflows.md) § WF-1  
> **Playbook:** [`vibe-operator-playbook.md`](./vibe-operator-playbook.md)

---

## When to use

User is on **Server Functions** (`pageKey: server-functions`) and wants a new or changed API/function.

## Manual UI parity (mandatory)

Simulate **Server Functions → Create / Save** — not ad-hoc file writes.

| Manual step | Agent equivalent |
|-------------|------------------|
| Name + HTTP method (+ optional catalog tags) | `draft_server_function` args: `name`, `method` (folder defaults to `general`) |
| Route path `/api/{name}` for new customs | `path` (default computed like UI catalog path) |
| Managed id `{folder}.{name}` | `functionId` on draft/change set (e.g. `general.sum-two-numbers`) |
| Source editor | `source` — sandbox TypeScript |
| Test Console payload | `testPayload` JSON |
| Save | proposal → this editor panel writes source into Monaco (Agent auto-applies). Catalog persist is still **Save** |

Operators do **not** set folder in the UI. Folder remains storage-only (default `general`). Rename and catalog tags are edited from the **list**, not the editor chrome.

**On disk after apply (same as UI Save):**

- `workspace/server-functions/custom/{folder}.{name}.ts`
- `workspace/server-functions/custom/{folder}.{name}.metadata.json`

Catalog tags persist in `metadataJson.catalogTags` (not OpenAPI `apiDoc.tags`).

**Never:** `draft_file_patch` under `workspace/server-functions/` — use `draft_server_function` only.

## Execute — do not re-ask

If the user message already states what to build (e.g. POST, inputs, logic), **do not** respond with "tell me what function you want". After retrieve:

1. `list_server_functions` — check for similar functions
2. `get_server_function` / `read_file` — read closest example (`useServerFunctionActions.handleCreateFunction`, `templates.ts`)
3. **`draft_server_function`** — name, folder, method, path, source, testPayload
4. **`test_server_function`** — verify on live runtime. On the editor, pass `source` + `payload` from the snapshot so the run matches Test Console Execute (unsaved Monaco + current payload). Read `lastRun.output` / `lastRun.logs` in the snapshot before guessing.
5. Proposal → the Server Functions editor AI panel writes `function_source_patch` / `draft_server_function` source into Monaco (Agent auto-applies). Catalog Save is still the operator Save button. Do not claim the editor changed without that apply. In the editor AI column, assistant code fences and apply cards show a **changed-line diff** against the current Monaco source (`codeDiffBaseline`), collapsed after five displayed lines — not a full handler dump.

## Source template

Managed functions use the sandbox runtime (`req`, `res`, `db`, `console`) — **never** `export default`, `import`, or `module.exports`:

```typescript
type EdgeReq = {
  body: Record<string, unknown>;
  query: Record<string, unknown>;
  params: Record<string, string>;
  method: string;
  headers: Record<string, string | undefined>;
};

type EdgeRes = {
  json: (data: unknown) => unknown;
  send: (data: unknown) => unknown;
  status: (code: number) => EdgeRes;
};

const edgeReq = req as EdgeReq;
const edgeRes = res as EdgeRes;

async function handler(): Promise<void> {
  // POST body: edgeReq.body
  edgeRes.json({ success: true, data: {} });
}

(async () => { await handler(); })();
```

Reference: `src/shared/api/contracts/server-functions/templates.ts` · `buildServerFunctionTemplate`.

## `draft_server_function` args

| Arg | Required | Notes |
|-----|----------|-------|
| `name` | yes | Slug name (e.g. `sum-two-numbers`) |
| `source` | yes | Full TypeScript source |
| `folder` | no | API folder segment (default `general`, e.g. `math`, `users`) |
| `method` | no | `GET` \| `POST` \| `PUT` \| `DELETE` \| `PATCH` — match semantics (POST when reading `req.body`) |
| `path` | no | Default `/api/{folder}/{name}` (same as UI) |
| `testPayload` | no | Test Console JSON — body fields at root (e.g. `{ "a": "", "b": "" }`); use `params` / `query` only for path/query params; POST default `{}` |
| `functionId` | no | Existing `{folder}.{name}` when patching |

## Route conventions

- REST: method = operation; path = resource
- POST write: read inputs from `edgeReq.body`
- Success envelope: `{ success: true, data, ... }`
- OpenAPI: [`server-functions-openapi.md`](./server-functions-openapi.md)

## Related shards

- `data-studio` — generated Data API routes
- `edge-openapi` — OpenAPI / Swagger
- `vibe-coding-workflows` — full WF-1..4 map

1|# UI grids and table columns
2|
3|> **Shard:** `ui-grid`  
4|> **List composition:** [`crud-pages.md`](./crud-pages.md) · **Footer sort:** [`ui-toolbar.md`](./ui-toolbar.md)  
5|> **Living sample:** Base Components → Grid / TreeGrid (Chrome + Paging).
6|
7|## Intent
8|
9|All table lists use `AppTableGrid`. Page lists use `chrome="classic"` (default). Embedded editors, dialogs, and property panels use `chrome="hero"`. One footer owns paging + sort.
10|
11|## Grid shell (`AppTableGrid`)
12|- All **page / CRUD list** and **embedded** grids through `AppTableGrid` + `APP_TABLE_GRID_*`.
13|- **Chrome** (`chrome`, default **`classic`**): same component, two visual treatments. Living sample: Base Components → Grid → Chrome (`classic` | `hero`).
14|  - **`classic`** — flush page list (margin 0, border 0). Current CRUD density (`py-3` cells, slate-300 header rule).
15|  - **`hero`** — joined 8px card (`APP_TABLE_GRID_JOINED_SHELL_CLASS`), airy rows (`py-4`), quieter header band, default margin **4px** / border **5px** (override with `margin` / `borderWidth`). Pair the `footer` slot with `GridPagingFooter chrome="hero"` so the paging band matches the card. Header top corners use `HERO_TABLE_HEADER_CORNER_CLASS`. Use `scrollOwner="panel"` when a parent panel should scroll (Column Properties, floating panels).
16|- Sticky headers; paging footer via `footer` slot (`GridPagingFooter`). Living sample: Base Components → Grid / TreeGrid → **Paging** (on/off plus pattern, page size, sort controls, summary). Default **on** for Grid; TreeGrid defaults **off** (product trees are not paged — see [`crud-pages.md`](./crud-pages.md)). Operators can still turn Paging on in the TreeGrid living sample.
17|- **Full-height list composition:** follow `UsersPageView.tsx`: page root `flex h-full min-h-0 w-full flex-col`; toolbar `shrink-0`; grid host `flex min-h-0 w-full flex-1 flex-col`; `AppTableGrid` owns the scroll body and renders the footer as `shrink-0`. **Height** (`fillHeight`, default `true` / **100%**) is that fill. Set `fillHeight={false}` (**content**) to hug rows instead of stretching. Living sample: Base Components → Grid / TreeGrid → Height (`100%` | `content`).
18|- **Flush header:** the grid host must directly follow the page toolbar with **zero** `gap`, `space-y-*`, margin, or padding, so the table header touches the toolbar bottom border. Do not fix structural spacing with global CSS selectors or `!important`.
19|- Optional content above a grid may add spacing only when it actually renders. React arrays are truthy even when empty: use `React.Children.count(children) > 0` (or an equivalent semantic check) before creating a spacer/wrapper such as `mb-2`.
20|- Generated Designer/CRUD pages must preserve the same composition as `UsersPageView.tsx` + `UserTableGrid.tsx`; generated output is accepted only when toolbar controls are vertically centered, the table header is flush below the toolbar, and the body fills through to `GridPagingFooter`.
21|- **Choose presentation by information density, not habit:** when a collection has only a few meaningful fields (typically a title plus about 1–3 compact attributes/status values), prefer `presentation="cards"` at every viewport. Use a table/grid when many comparable columns, dense scanning, or cross-row column alignment materially helps the operator.
22|- **Adaptive presentation:** `presentation` (`table` | `cards` | `table-scroll` | `auto`; default **`auto`**) + optional `cardBelow` (`phone` | `tablet` | `desktop`; default **`tablet`**). In `auto`: phone → 1 card per row, tablet → 2 cards per row, desktop+ → table. `cardBelow="phone"` keeps tablet as horizontal table-scroll with a frozen first column; `cardBelow="desktop"` uses cards at every size (including wide) — only when each record is a self-contained item, not a comparison task. Column mode only. Do not ship page lists as `presentation="table"` unless the operator must compare many columns on compact screens.
23|- **Compact viewport policy** (`compact.phone` / `compact.tablet`) overlays that preset so every `AppTableGrid` can control tablet/phone independently:
24|  - `layout`: `keep-table` (stay a grid) | `table-scroll` (horizontal table + freeze first column by default) | `cards`.
25|  - Phone cards are locked to **one card per row**. Tablet list cards default to **2** per row. Desktop/wide card lists default to **2** per row so a wide pane is not a single stacked stream. **Cards in the same row share equal height** (`items-stretch` + `h-full` card shell).
26|  - `freezeFirstColumn`, `collapseExtraFields` + `visibleFieldCount` (More/Less), `showActions`, `showMeta`.
27|- Living sample: Base Components → Grid / TreeGrid → Presentation + Compact viewport (same labels and values). Designer inspector fields `compactPhoneLayout` / `compactTabletLayout` / `compactTabletCardsPerRow` / … map to the same contract. TreeGrid `cards` is stacked rows; it omits table-scroll, freeze-first-column, and cards-per-row. TreeGrid stacked rows still support field-label chrome and action placement; AppTableGrid standard cards use fixed label rules and footer actions only.
28|- **Standard card layout** (single built-in card view — no presets): row 1 = optional `media` at logical start beside the first three data fields (`title` + `subtitle` + `field`, no labels); solo `media` centers in the card. Remaining `field` / `meta` rows render below as one-line `label:value` rows (`truncate`). `media` never shows a field label. Pass row actions via `getCardRowActions` — footer only; non-delete actions start, `intent="delete"` end.
29|- **Card metadata** on `AppTableGridColumnDef`: `card.role` (`title` | `subtitle` | `meta` | `field` | `media` | `actions` | `hidden`), optional `card.label` / `card.priority`; `card.phoneRole` / `card.tabletRole` override role on that viewport (`hidden` drops the column from cards). `hideBelow` (`md` | `lg`) hides the column in **table, table-scroll, and card** layouts below that breakpoint (`md` = phone, `lg` = phone+tablet). Reuse existing `renderCell` (boolean icons, dates, actions semantics unchanged).
30|- **Card actions:** compact `showActions: false` hides row actions on cards. Card actions always render in the footer when `getCardRowActions` is provided.
31|- **Sticky header scroll:** when `stickyHeader` is on (default) and the grid owns vertical scroll (`scrollOwner="self"`), the header band stays fixed and **only the row body scrolls** (split table layout). Horizontal scroll appears **only on the body**; the header tracks body `scrollLeft` via transform (no second scrollbar). The header band uses `overflow-hidden` to clip that horizontal transform — column filter popovers and the column-layout menu must **portal to `document.body`** (fixed, same pattern as `AppGridRowActions` overflow) so they are not clipped by the band or covered by the body. Pad the header band with the body’s vertical scrollbar width (`padding-inline-end` from `offsetWidth - clientWidth`) so header and body tables share the same content width — otherwise Title still lines up and later headers sit ahead of their cells. Paint that gutter with the same header fill and bottom rule as the thead (`bg-slate-100` on the band, plus `APP_TABLE_GRID_THEAD_BAND_CLASS` / hero equivalent) so the corner above the body scrollbar is not a white break. Set `stickyHeader={false}` to scroll header + rows together.
32|- **Cell padding:** `cellPaddingX` (default **5**) is left and right padding on **every** column (header + body). Override per grid; living sample: Base Components → Grid → Cell padding. Applied via `--app-table-grid-cell-px` on `APP_TABLE_GRID_TABLE_CLASS`. Standalone tables that cannot use the table class: `appTableGridCellPxClass()` / `appTableGridHeaderCellClass()`.
33|- **Cell overflow:** body cells clip at the column edge (`table-fixed` + `overflow-hidden` on `APP_TABLE_GRID_TABLE_CLASS` / `APP_TABLE_GRID_BODY_CELL_CLASS`). Default inner wrap is `APP_TABLE_GRID_CELL_CLIP_CLASS` (`truncate` / ellipsis). Set `wrap: true` on a column to use `APP_TABLE_GRID_CELL_WRAP_CLASS` (`whitespace-pre-wrap break-words`) so long text stacks onto extra lines instead of a single-line ellipsis. Header cells stay overflow-visible; filter popovers and the column-layout menu still portal out of the split header band. Fix this in the base grid, not per page.
34|- **Leftover width:** `table-fixed` + `w-full` leftover goes to the unconstrained column (typically Title). Compact columns keep their authored widths and sit next to Actions. Do not insert a dead spacer/`__filler__` column — that empty band between Timeline and Actions is leftover width in the wrong place, and two unconstrained columns make split header/body tables disagree.
35|- **Column resize:** default **on**. Drag the header edge to set width. Widths restore from browser `localStorage` when `persistListKey` is set (same list-prefs blob as paging/sort). Per-column `layout.resizable` defaults true; set `false` (or `layout={false}`) to lock a column. Selection and typical Actions columns stay locked. Hide/reorder/pin stay behind `enableColumnLayout`. Living sample: Base Components → Grid.
36|
37|## Column sort/filter
38|- Use `AppTableGridColumnDef` + `useGridQueryState`.
39|- Per-column `sort`/`filter`; modes `client` or `server`.
40|- Client mode needs `getSortValue` / `getFilterValue`.
41|- Header icons: client stroke `1.25`, server `2.75`; `title`/`aria-label` include `(client-side)` or `(server-side)`.
42|- Filter popovers: draft-then-apply; icon-only confirm/cancel; body-portaled so the sticky header band cannot clip them. Flip horizontal align (and vertical side) when the viewport has no room — last columns open toward the start, not off-screen.
43|- Server-sliced pages: `gridQueryMode="server"`.
44|- Optional `getCellClassName(row)` merges with `cellClassName`. CRUD Set column `conditionalFormat` maps onto this. Do not invent a second cell-style engine.
45|
46|## List modes
47|- Paging + Infinite Scroll; user can switch.
48|- `useGridListPresentation`; mode switch in footer.
49|- Default page size `50`; options `50`–`10000` (`gridPagingConstants.ts`).
50|- Label-style dropdowns for page size/sort field; icon toggle for sort direction.
51|- **Package / Designer list grids:** if the footer is shown (`showPagingFooter` / pagination on), also enable footer **sort field + direction** (`showSortControls`, `sortOptions`) — see [`package-ui.md`](./package-ui.md) §P3 and [`ui-toolbar.md`](./ui-toolbar.md) §List/catalog footer sort. Do not ship a paging footer without sort controls unless the plan strips pagination entirely.
52|- **Dialog inset:** paging footers inside dialogs use **10px** left/right inset from the window edge (`CREATE_EDIT_MODAL_GRID_PAGING_FOOTER_CLASS`, auto via `DialogHostContext` under `AppDialogShell`). `chrome="hero"` skips that inset: classic paging, hero body fill, joined rounded shell around grid + footer (`HERO_TABLE_JOINED_SHELL_CLASS`, `borderWidth` default 5px).
53|- **Client remember:** list filters + pagination settings (`pageSize`, `listMode`), column sort/filter (`useGridQueryState` with `persistListKey`), and **column resize widths** persist in **browser `localStorage` only** via `usePersistedListPaging` / `usePersistedListFilters` + `APP_LIST_PREFERENCE_KEYS` / AppTableGrid `persistListKey` — not user profile / server attributes. Do not persist current page number.
54|
55|## Actions column
56|- No visible header title.
57|- Render through `AppGridRowActions` when a row has more than one icon action. Show up to `maxVisibleActions` (default 3) inline 20px tools; extra actions collapse into a `MoreHorizontal` dropdown (fixed portal menu so overflow-hidden grid shells do not clip it).
58|- 20px per **visible** slot (inline icons + overflow trigger); width = padding + (20 × slot count) + (7 × (slot count − 1)). Use `gridActionsColumnWidth(resolveGridActionSlotCount(actionCount, maxVisible))`.
59|- Conditional actions stay visible but disabled (`text-slate-400`).
60|- Semantics: View/Test=cyan, Access=`KeyRound`+`GRID_ACTION_ACCESS_CLASS`, Edit=indigo, Activate=emerald, Lock=amber, Delete=rose.
61|- Card/stacked surfaces honor `cardActionsPlacement`: footer, header, or none.
62|
63|## Boolean / date / audit columns
64|- Booleans: `Check` emerald / `X` rose icons only; `-` for null.
65|- Dates: center-aligned, `YYYY-MM-DD` only.
66|- `_by` columns: plain text, not clickable.
67|- Created/Updated width: `150px` (`APP_TABLE_GRID_AUDIT_COLUMN_WIDTH`).
68|
69|## Grid image payloads
70|- List/grid endpoints: thumbnails only; full size on detail endpoints.
71|
72|**IDs:** `ui.grid.*`, `data.images.grid-thumbnail-only`.

> **Audience:** in-app AppEndO Agent (not the IDE assistant)  
> **Shard:** `vibe-operator-playbook`  
> **Workflows:** [`vibe-coding-workflows.md`](./vibe-coding-workflows.md)

---

## 1. What you are

You are **AppEndO Agent** — not a generic IDE assistant. You develop **inside** the live AppEndO admin platform using its standards, templates, and tool pipeline.

| Principle | Rule |
|-----------|------|
| **Live runtime** | Server Functions and Component Designer layouts apply to **this same running instance** — no separate sandbox, sidecar, or deploy pipeline. |
| **Platform-constrained** | Use AppEndO patterns only (HeroUI v3, `AppTableGrid`, `UiCheckbox`, `CreateEditModalShell`, `AppButton`, `surfaceClasses`, managed Server Functions, Component Designer). |
| **Retrieve first** | Never cite code, standards, or file contents you have not retrieved this session. |
| **Proposal pipeline** | All writes go through `draft_*` → proposal → apply API. AppEndoo **auto-applies** valid proposals in Agent mode — never ask the user to click Create/Apply or save manually. |
| **Greenfield** | No legacy parsers, dual formats, runtime migration, or deprecated shims. |

| **Plans** | `plans/core/`, `plans/packages/` | Plan mode · `draft_file_patch` for `.md` only |

**Manual operator parity (mandatory):** When the user could do the work in the admin UI, simulate that exact path — do not invent alternate file trees or shortcuts.

| Task | Manual UI | Agent MUST | NEVER |
|------|-----------|------------|-------|
| Server Function create/edit | Server Functions → Create / Save | `draft_server_function` → proposal → panel auto-apply | `draft_file_patch` on `workspace/server-functions/` |
| Component layout | Component Designer | `draft_component_layout` / `draft_application_scaffold` | ad-hoc JSON under `workspace/designer/` |
| Platform source | allowlisted edit | `draft_file_patch` on allowlisted `src/` paths | writing to `runtime/` except rows above |

**Code navigation flow:** `get_feature_graph(pageKey)` → `search_codebase({ pageKey })` → `read_file(startLine/endLine)`.

retrieve → plan → draft → finalize

| **finalize** | Validate standards · max 2 repair loops | `validateProposal` → proposal UI |

**Retrieve gate:** `draft_*` tools are **blocked** until at least one retrieve tool succeeds in this run.

---

## 4. First actions on every coding task

1. `get_project_standards({ shard: "vibe-operator-playbook" })` — this document.
2. `get_project_standards({ shard: "<active-workflow-shard>" })` — from **## Active vibe workflow** in system context (e.g. `vibe-server-function`, `vibe-crud`, `vibe-designer-edit`, `vibe-coding-workflows`).

Load `get_project_standards({ shard })` — one shard, not all:

`layoutId` or `selectedNodeId` is in page context — user is editing an open Component Designer layout (Live Designer).

# Workflowهای وایب‌کدینگ داخلی AppEndO

> **Shard:** `vibe-coding-workflows` (alias `appendoo-workflows`)  
> **Playbook:** [`vibe-operator-playbook.md`](./vibe-operator-playbook.md)  
> **Spec:** `specs/vibe-coding/01-spec.md`

---

## Runtime واحد (بدون انجین جدا)

وایب‌کدینگ روی **همان instance زنده AppEndO** اجرا می‌شود:

| لایه | بعد از apply |
|------|--------------|
| **Server** | Server Function → API/route فوری از runtime موجود (`workspace/server-functions/`) |
| **Client** | layout → preview/route در همان app (`workspace/designer/drafts/` · Designer handoff) |

نیازی به deploy جدا، Docker sidecar، یا engine اختصاصی vibe نیست. `test_server_function` و (VC-4) `run_tests` روی **همین** runtime هستند.

Benchmark: [`vibe-coding-benchmarks.md`](../architecture/vibe-coding-benchmarks.md) § Unified live runtime.

---

## پیش‌نیازهای مشترک

| مورد | توضیح |
|------|--------|
| **Mode** | **Agent** (نه Ask/Plan برای write) |
| **Model** | `capabilities.tools: true` |
| **Confirm** | همهٔ writeها via proposal + apply API (`writeRequiresConfirm`); AiPanel در Agent mode proposal معتبر را خودکار apply می‌کند |
| **Packهای پیش‌فرض (هدف p-50)** | files · codebase · standards · context · **server-functions** · **designer** |

---

## WF-1 — سرویس جدید (Server Functions)

**هدف:** API/منطق backend جدید در managed Server Functions.

**Preconditions:**

- کاربر در **Server Functions** (`pageKey: server-functions`)
- pack `appendo-server-functions` فعال

**ترتیب tool (هدف harness):**

1. `get_project_standards({ shard: "vibe-server-function" })` یا query `vibe-server-function`
2. `list_server_functions` / `get_server_function` (اگر مشابه وجود دارد)
3. `read_file` روی نمونه یا contract مرتبط (retrieve gate)
4. `draft_server_function`
5. `test_server_function`
6. proposal → **panel auto-apply** (معتبر در Agent mode)
7. (VC-4) post-apply verify / `run_tests`

**Rollback:** `/api/ai/agent/rollback` پس از apply.

**استانداردها:** [`data-studio.md`](./data-studio.md) · [`server-functions-openapi.md`](./server-functions-openapi.md)

---

## WF-2 — UI CRUD جدید (Client Components)

**هدف:** grid + form CRUD با Component Designer.

**Preconditions:**

- WF-1 انجام شده یا API موجود است
- کاربر در **Client Components** / Designer
- pack `appendo-designer` + `appendo-files` فعال

**ترتیب tool:**

1. `get_project_standards({ shard: "crud-set" })` for a CRUD Set, else `vibe-crud`
2. `get_page_context` · `get_feature_graph({ pageKey: "client-components" })`
3. `search_codebase` + `read_file` روی template/preset مشابه
4. `draft_component_layout` (templateId یا document) — برای **چند صفحه + Shell + منو** از `draft_application_scaffold` استفاده کن (orchestration روی همان draft_component_layout)
5. proposal → panel auto-apply → **Designer handoff** (`/client-components?load=…`)

**UI rules:** HeroUI · `AppTableGrid` · `UiCheckbox` · [`ui-core.md`](./ui-core.md) · [`ui-grid.md`](./ui-grid.md)

---

## WF-3 — تغییر grid/form موجود

**هدف:** اصلاح layout منتشرشده یا draft (مثلاً ستون boolean به icon).

**Preconditions:**

- `layoutId` در `pageContext` (Designer باز است)
- pack designer + standards

**ترتیب tool:**

1. `get_page_context` — `layoutId` · `selectedNodeId`
2. `read_file` روی generated/preview در صورت نیاز
3. (VC-5) `designer_set_prop` / `designer_insert_palette_item` یا `draft_component_layout` از `baseLayoutId`
4. `validateProposal` (standards heuristics)
5. panel auto-apply → باز کردن Designer

**الهام Zed:** multi-buffer diff review قبل از confirm (VC-5).

---

## WF-4 — Full-stack (Server Function + UI)

**هدف:** feature کامل از backend تا UI در یک session یا دو session پشت‌سرهم.

**فاز A — Backend (همان WF-1)**

**فاز B — UI (همان WF-2)** با binding به API جدید

**Harness phases (هدف VC-2):**

```
retrieve → plan → draft → finalize
```

| Phase | Tools مجاز |
|-------|------------|
| retrieve | graph · search · read · get_server_function · standards |
| plan | structured plan artifact (intent · files · steps) |
| draft | `draft_*` فقط پس از retrieve gate |
| finalize | validate · repair (max 2) · proposal |

**محدودیت proposal:** `vibeMaxFilesPerProposal` (هدف: 12 full-stack) · `vibeMaxLinesPerProposal`

---

## Shard keys برای `get_project_standards`

| Shard key | محتوا |
|-----------|--------|
| `vibe-coding-workflows` | این سند (خلاصه WF-1..4) |
| `vibe-operator-playbook` | playbook Agent · runtime زنده · قالب پروژه |
| `vibe-server-function` | WF-1 + template sandbox · `draft_server_function` |
| `vibe-crud` | WF-2 leftover (non CRUD Set) |
| `crud-set` | CRUD Set: one `CrudSet`, wizard sets props |
| `vibe-designer-edit` | WF-3 + component-designer |
| `vibe-benchmarks` | pointer به [`vibe-coding-benchmarks.md`](../architecture/vibe-coding-benchmarks.md) |

Query mode: `get_project_standards({ query: "vibe-crud" })`

---

## چه زمانی Cursor بماند

| سناریو | AppEndO کافی | Cursor بهتر |
|--------|--------------|-------------|
| Server Function + Designer CRUD | بله (WF-1/2) | — |
| refactor گسترده `src/server/` | پس از VC-1 allowlist | بله (index + IDE) |
| debug تعاملی deep | محدود | بله |
| استاندارد UI/platform | **AppEndO** (`get_project_standards`) | rules دستی |

راهنمای عملی: [`docs/archive/internal/vibe-coding-howto-fa.md`](../archive/internal/vibe-coding-howto-fa.md)

---

## خطا و recovery

| خطا | اقدام |
|-----|--------|
| validation violation | repair loop (VC-2) یا reject و prompt دقیق‌تر |
| apply fail | پیام در AiPanel · fix دستی یا retry |
| post-apply verify fail | banner قرمز + لیست checks در AiPanel (VC-4.2) · rollback یا fix دستی |

# WF-1 — Server Functions (vibe shard)

> **Shard key:** `get_project_standards({ shard: "vibe-server-function" })`  
> **Workflow:** [`vibe-coding-workflows.md`](./vibe-coding-workflows.md) § WF-1  
> **Playbook:** [`vibe-operator-playbook.md`](./vibe-operator-playbook.md)

---

## When to use

User is on **Server Functions** (`pageKey: server-functions`) and wants a new or changed API/function.

## Manual UI parity (mandatory)

Simulate **Server Functions → Create / Save** — not ad-hoc file writes.

| Manual step | Agent equivalent |
|-------------|------------------|
| Name + HTTP method (+ optional catalog tags) | `draft_server_function` args: `name`, `method` (folder defaults to `general`) |
| Route path `/api/{name}` for new customs | `path` (default computed like UI catalog path) |
| Managed id `{folder}.{name}` | `functionId` on draft/change set (e.g. `general.sum-two-numbers`) |
| Source editor | `source` — sandbox TypeScript |
| Test Console payload | `testPayload` JSON |
| Save | proposal → this editor panel writes source into Monaco (Agent auto-applies). Catalog persist is still **Save** |

Operators do **not** set folder in the UI. Folder remains storage-only (default `general`). Rename and catalog tags are edited from the **list**, not the editor chrome.

**On disk after apply (same as UI Save):**

- `workspace/server-functions/custom/{folder}.{name}.ts`
- `workspace/server-functions/custom/{folder}.{name}.metadata.json`

Catalog tags persist in `metadataJson.catalogTags` (not OpenAPI `apiDoc.tags`).

**Never:** `draft_file_patch` under `workspace/server-functions/` — use `draft_server_function` only.

## Execute — do not re-ask

If the user message already states what to build (e.g. POST, inputs, logic), **do not** respond with "tell me what function you want". After retrieve:

1. `list_server_functions` — check for similar functions
2. `get_server_function` / `read_file` — read closest example (`useServerFunctionActions.handleCreateFunction`, `templates.ts`)
3. **`draft_server_function`** — name, folder, method, path, source, testPayload
4. **`test_server_function`** — verify on live runtime. On the editor, pass `source` + `payload` from the snapshot so the run matches Test Console Execute (unsaved Monaco + current payload). Read `lastRun.output` / `lastRun.logs` in the snapshot before guessing.
5. Proposal → the Server Functions editor AI panel writes `function_source_patch` / `draft_server_function` source into Monaco (Agent auto-applies). Catalog Save is still the operator Save button. Do not claim the editor changed without that apply. In the editor AI column, assistant code fences and apply cards show a **changed-line diff** against the current Monaco source (`codeDiffBaseline`), collapsed after five displayed lines — not a full handler dump.

## Source template

Managed functions use the sandbox runtime (`req`, `res`, `db`, `console`) — **never** `export default`, `import`, or `module.exports`:

```typescript
type EdgeReq = {
  body: Record<string, unknown>;
  query: Record<string, unknown>;
  params: Record<string, string>;
  method: string;
  headers: Record<string, string | undefined>;
};

type EdgeRes = {
  json: (data: unknown) => unknown;
  send: (data: unknown) => unknown;
  status: (code: number) => EdgeRes;
};

const edgeReq = req as EdgeReq;
const edgeRes = res as EdgeRes;

async function handler(): Promise<void> {
  // POST body: edgeReq.body
  edgeRes.json({ success: true, data: {} });
}

(async () => { await handler(); })();
```

Reference: `src/shared/api/contracts/server-functions/templates.ts` · `buildServerFunctionTemplate`.

## `draft_server_function` args

| Arg | Required | Notes |
|-----|----------|-------|
| `name` | yes | Slug name (e.g. `sum-two-numbers`) |
| `source` | yes | Full TypeScript source |
| `folder` | no | API folder segment (default `general`, e.g. `math`, `users`) |
| `method` | no | `GET` \| `POST` \| `PUT` \| `DELETE` \| `PATCH` — match semantics (POST when reading `req.body`) |
| `path` | no | Default `/api/{folder}/{name}` (same as UI) |
| `testPayload` | no | Test Console JSON — body fields at root (e.g. `{ "a": "", "b": "" }`); use `params` / `query` only for path/query params; POST default `{}` |
| `functionId` | no | Existing `{folder}.{name}` when patching |

## Route conventions

- REST: method = operation; path = resource
- POST write: read inputs from `edgeReq.body`
- Success envelope: `{ success: true, data, ... }`
- OpenAPI: [`server-functions-openapi.md`](./server-functions-openapi.md)

## Related shards

- `data-studio` — generated Data API routes

# WF-2 — Client CRUD UI (vibe shard)

> **Shard key:** `get_project_standards({ shard: "vibe-crud" })`  
> **Workflow:** [`vibe-coding-workflows.md`](./vibe-coding-workflows.md) § WF-2  
> **Playbook:** [`vibe-operator-playbook.md`](./vibe-operator-playbook.md)

---

## When to use

User is on **Client Components** (`pageKey: client-components`) and wants a new grid + form CRUD bound to an API.

**CRUD Set** (one `CrudSet`: list + creates + purpose/content patches + delete, Users-like): load shard `crud-set` and skill `.claude/skills/appendo-crud-set`. Ask `CRUD_SET_FIRST_QUESTION`, fill `CrudSetSpec`, then render one `CrudSet`. This vibe shard is the leftover path for a one-off grid/form that is **not** a CRUD Set.

## Execute — do not re-ask

If the user already described the CRUD (entity, columns, API), after retrieve call **`draft_component_layout`** — do not ask them to repeat. For a **multi-page application** (list+detail, portal with several screens), call **`draft_application_scaffold`** instead (orchestrates shell + pages + menu via `draft_component_layout`).

## Tool order

1. `get_feature_graph({ pageKey: "client-components" })`
2. `search_codebase` + `read_file` — similar layout/template
3. **`draft_component_layout`** (single screen) **or** **`draft_application_scaffold`** (multi-page + shell + menu)
4. Proposal → confirm → apply → **Designer handoff**

## UI rules (mandatory)

| Control | Use |
|---------|-----|
| Grids | `AppTableGrid` |
| Booleans | `UiCheckbox` — never native checkbox |
| Buttons | `AppButton` intents from `buttonSemantics.ts` |
| Modals | `CreateEditModalShell` |
| Labels | `ps-[4px]` + 2px gap to control |
| Page guide | Every generated field must have `label` + `hint` (plain-language sentence). Auto-form/CRUD builders emit `hint`; canvas/export wrap the control with `data-page-guide*`. After a manual `designer_insert_palette_item`, set `hint` via `designer_set_prop`. |

## Related shards

- `crud-set` — unified `CrudSet` (`CrudSetSpec` as props); prefer this over this shard
- `crud-pages` — CRUD page patterns
- `ui-grid` — columns, paging, actions
- `ui-core` — forms, shell, typography
- `data-studio` — when the API is generated from a Data Studio model
- **`package-ui`** — operational package Phase 3 gate (lists · main/rail editors · vocab · scaffold); use for CMS/CRM-style packages instead of inventing chrome
- `package-base-info-vocab` — shared Base Info vocab form for package settings
